prompt: In a flat vector illustration of a snowy town square, a woman in a blue coat stands on the left holding a steaming mug. To the right, an old man in a gray scarf looks at the snowman with a gentle smile. A brown dog with floppy ears runs past the bench, chasing a red ball that rolls near the old man's feet. The scene is crisp and clean, emphasizing simple shapes and bold colors without shading. There is no visible sun or sky gradient, keeping the focus entirely on the figures and their immediate surroundings. The woman remains stationary while the child gestures upward. The dog moves dynamically across the foreground. The snowman remains still as the central anchor. The old man observes quietly from his position. All elements are distinct and easily recognizable by their color and form alone.
